mapper.select: select appeal_id, case_id, action_id, appellant_id, reason, evidence, status, reviewer_id, review_result, review_time, create_time from lf_appeal where appeal_id = #{appealId}

select appeal_id, case_id, action_id, appellant_id, reason, evidence, status, reviewer_id, review_result, review_time, create_time from lf_appeal where appellant_id = #{appellantId} order by create_time desc, appeal_id desc
mapper.update: update lf_appeal set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_result = #{reviewResult}, review_time = sysdate() where appeal_id = #{appealId} and status = 'SUBMITTED'
